**Three-tier freemium model:**

| Tier | Price | Key differentiators |
|------|-------|---------------------|
| Free | $0 | Unlimited notes, 2 devices, 1 GB — genuinely usable |
| Pro | $7/mo ($70/yr) | Unlimited devices, AI assistant included (not an add-on), 90-day version history |
| Team | $9/user/mo ($90/yr) | Shared workspaces, real-time collaboration, team AI context, SSO included |

**Key decisions:**
- Priced in the underserved $3–8/mo cross-platform gap identified by else
- AI bundled into Pro rather than sold as an add-on — deliberate contrast with Notion's $10/mo AI tax
- No per-feature add-ons anywhere — clean pricing as a trust signal
- Revenue model projects ~$84K ARR at 1,000 paying customers
- Freemium over paid-only: the category has trained users to try before buying; Roam Research's paid-only approach lost ground to free alternatives
